import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int y, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int y, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.y = y;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final long INF64 = (long)1e18;
    static final int N = 1000007;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[N];
    static ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static long ans = 0;
    static long[] dist = new long[N];
    static int[] pred = new int[N];
    static int[] pe = new int[N];
    static int[] inq = new int[N];

    static int source = N - 2;
    static int target = N - 1;

    static int norm(int a) {
        return ((a % 1000000007) + 1000000007) % 1000000007;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((a * 1L * b) % 1000000007);
    }

    static int binPow(int a, int k) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                ans = mul(ans, a);
            }
            a = mul(a, a);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        int b = binPow(a, 1000000007 - 2);
        assert mul(a, b) == 1;
        return b;
    }

    static int residualCapacity(int x) {
        Edge edge = e.get(x);
        return edge.capacity - edge.flow;
    }

    static void pushFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF64);
        Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        inq[source] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int k = q.poll();
            inq[k] = 0;
            for (int x : g[k]) {
                if (residualCapacity(x) == 0) continue;
                Edge edge = e.get(x);
                int y = edge.y;
                int cost = edge.cost;
                if (dist[y] > dist[k] + cost) {
                    dist[y] = dist[k] + cost;
                    pred[y] = k;
                    pe[y] = x;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int cur = target;
        while (cur != source) {
            int edgeIdx = pe[cur];
            e.get(edgeIdx).flow++;
            e.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow--;
            cur = pred[cur];
        }
        ans += dist[target];
    }

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int capacity, int cost) {
        g[x].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(y, capacity, 0, cost));
        g[y].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(x, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static int n, m, k, c, d;

    static void input(Scanner sc) {
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            addEdge(source, x, 1, 0);
        }

        int timeLayers = 101;
        for (int i = 0; i < timeLayers; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, target, k, i * c);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(x + j * n, y + j * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(y + j * n, x + j * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + j * n + n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            pushFlow();
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void solve() {
        // No additional implementation needed as logic is in input()
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        input(sc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
